title: 14× faster embeddings: how we rebuilt the ONNX path in Manticore
summary: ManticoreSearch rebuilt their ONNX runtime integration path for embeddings, achieving a 14x performance speedup. The optimization involves efficient vector computation and inference pipeline improvements for full-text and vector hybrid search capabilities.
problem_solved: Accelerates embedding computation and vector similarity search in ManticoreSearch database to enable faster AI-powered search capabilities.
why_valuable: 14x performance improvement enables real-time AI search at scale while maintaining accuracy, critical for production search applications.
